collections.title: The Masterpieces
collections.description: Iconic paintings from across art history — ready to display with full museum placards.

items.title: The Starry Night
items.description_narrative: A swirling, dynamic night sky over a quiet village, painted during Van Gogh's stay at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole asylum in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. It is one of the most recognized masterpieces in the history of Western art.
items.tags: night, sky, stars, village, post-impressionism, landscape

items.title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
items.medium: Polychrome woodblock print; ink and color on paper
items.description_narrative: An enormous rogue wave threatening three boats off the coast of the town of Kanagawa, while Mount Fuji rises in the background. It is Hokusai's most famous work and one of the most recognizable works of Japanese art in the world.
items.tags: wave, ocean, boats, mount fuji, ukiyo-e, landscape

items.title: The Kiss
items.medium: Oil and gold leaf on canvas
items.description_narrative: A couple locked in an intimate embrace, cloaked in elaborate gold-patterned robes, kneeling in a flower-strewn meadow. Klimt's masterful use of gold leaf and ornamental motifs epitomizes his 'Golden Phase' and the height of the Vienna Secession movement.
items.tags: love, gold, art nouveau, couple, embrace, ornamental

items.title: The Birth of Venus
items.description_narrative: The goddess Venus emerges from the sea as a fully grown woman, arriving at the shore on a giant scallop shell. One of the world's most famous and appreciated works of art, it has become a landmark of Italian Renaissance painting.
items.tags: mythology, venus, renaissance, goddess, shell, classical

items.title: Nighthawks
items.description_narrative: Four figures sit in a brightly lit diner at night on a desolate city corner. The painting captures the loneliness and alienation of modern urban life with cinematic intensity. It has become one of the most reproduced paintings in American art.
items.tags: diner, night, urban, loneliness, realism, american

items.title: Water Lilies
items.description_narrative: Part of Monet's iconic series of approximately 250 oil paintings depicting his flower garden at Giverny. The water lily paintings collectively represent Monet's greatest artistic achievement, capturing the fleeting effects of light on water with unmatched mastery.
items.tags: water lilies, pond, impressionism, flowers, nature, reflections

collections.title: Faces of Antiquity
collections.description: Portraits that have stared back at us across the centuries.

items.title: Mona Lisa
items.description_narrative: The most famous painting in the world. It depicts Lisa Gherardini, wife of Francesco del Giocondo, sitting in front of an imaginary landscape. Her enigmatic expression and the masterful use of sfumato make it a masterpiece of the Renaissance.

items.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
items.description_narrative: Often referred to as the 'Mona Lisa of the North', this tronie depicts a European girl wearing an exotic dress, an oriental turban, and what appears to be a very large pearl as an earring. It is a masterclass in the use of light.
items.tags: portrait, dutch golden age, pearl, turban, female

items.title: American Gothic
items.description_narrative: A stern-faced farmer standing beside his spinster daughter in front of a house with a distinctive Gothic window. One of the most familiar images in 20th-century American art, it is an ambiguous statement about rural American character.
items.tags: portrait, american, gothic, rural, farmer, pitchfork

items.title: Whistler's Mother
items.description_narrative: Formally titled 'Arrangement in Grey and Black No.1', this austere portrait of Whistler's mother seated in profile has become an American cultural icon and symbol of motherhood. Its restrained palette and compositional harmony exemplify Whistler's belief in art for art's sake.
items.tags: portrait, mother, seated, profile, tonalism, grey

items.title: Self-Portrait with Straw Hat
items.description_narrative: One of over thirty self-portraits by Van Gogh, painted during his time in Paris. The vibrant, short brushstrokes and complementary colors show the influence of the Impressionists and Neo-Impressionists he encountered in the French capital.

collections.title: The Cosmos
collections.description: Public-domain views of Earth and deep space from NASA, Hubble, and the James Webb Space Telescope — photography as fine art.
collections.license: Public Domain (NASA, U.S. Government work); Hubble/Webb composites credit NASA/ESA

items.title: The Blue Marble
items.description_narrative: One of the most reproduced photographs in history, captured by the crew of Apollo 17 on their way to the Moon. A fully illuminated Earth — Africa, Antarctica, and the Arabian Peninsula clearly visible — hangs against the black of space, a portrait of our entire world.
items.tags: earth, space, apollo, nasa, photography, planet

items.title: Earthrise
items.description_narrative: Taken by astronaut William Anders during Apollo 8, the first crewed voyage to orbit the Moon. The sight of Earth rising over the desolate lunar horizon became an enduring symbol of the fragility and unity of our home planet.
items.tags: earth, moon, apollo, nasa, photography, horizon

items.title: Webb's First Deep Field (SMACS 0723)
items.description_narrative: The first full-color image from the James Webb Space Telescope, revealing thousands of galaxies in a sliver of sky. The galaxy cluster SMACS 0723 bends spacetime as a gravitational lens, magnifying far more distant galaxies behind it — among the faintest objects ever observed.
items.tags: galaxies, deep field, jwst, webb, infrared, cosmos

items.title: Pillars of Creation
items.description_narrative: Towering columns of interstellar gas and dust in the Eagle Nebula, where new stars are being born. Captured by the Hubble Space Telescope, this image became one of the most iconic astronomical photographs ever made.
items.tags: nebula, stars, hubble, eagle nebula, space, gas

items.title: The Hubble Ultra Deep Field
items.description_narrative: A view of a seemingly empty patch of sky that, after a million-second exposure, revealed nearly 10,000 galaxies stretching back to within a few hundred million years of the Big Bang. It remains among the deepest images of the universe ever taken.
items.tags: galaxies, deep field, hubble, universe, cosmos, telescope
